name: Apple Music 榜单
description: 抓取 Apple Music 中国区官方榜单并同步到本地库：每日热门歌曲（charts API）、每周热门 100 首（大陆/全球/香港/韩/日/美，官方歌单 ID 永久固定）、城市 Top 25（上海/北京/成都/广州/武汉）、热门歌单排行（官方 RSS 每日动态排名）。歌曲自带标题/歌手/专辑/时长，门禁四维核实有料可核。首页以「本地歌单」分区直接展示已入库榜单，无需导入即可播放。同时支持搜索 Apple Music 官方歌单与歌曲：歌单页/歌曲页「聚合」搜索或单独搜索并导入，歌曲搜索同时作为歌单导入门禁的同平台核实源。Apple 无全曲直链（仅 30s 试听），落库为空直链 web 行，首播自动换源出流。
author: ray5378

configSchema.label: 选择榜单（可多选）

options.label: 热门歌单排行 TopN（每日动态）

configSchema.help: 选择要同步的 Apple Music 官方榜单/歌单，可以多选。每周热门/城市榜/固定歌单的 pl. ID 由 Apple 官方长期维护，内容自动更新。

configSchema.label: 热门歌单排行数量
configSchema.help: 选择「热门歌单排行 TopN」时,每日同步榜单前几名官方歌单(1~30,默认 10)

configSchema.label: 首页展示歌单数
configSchema.help: 首页「本地歌单」展示多少个已入库榜单(1~50,默认 6)

configSchema.label: 首页显示顺序
configSchema.help: 数值越小越靠前。QQ榜单(30)/酷狗榜单(31)/网易云榜单(32)/华为音乐榜单(33)/Apple Music榜单(34)按此值在首页「本地歌单」分区排列(1~100,默认 34)

configSchema.label: 歌单筛选平台
configSchema.help: 选择在歌单页「筛选歌单」下拉中显示哪些平台,未选中的平台不会出现在筛选列表。默认全选。

configSchema.label: 参与每日定时同步
configSchema.help: 关闭后,每天定点那次自动同步会跳过本插件(手动刷新按钮仍然可用)。

configSchema.label: 容器启动时拉取一次
configSchema.help: 打开后,MusicFlow 每次启动/重启会补拉一次本插件的歌单(适合榜单类插件保持最新)。

documentation:
### 功能介绍
自动抓取 Apple Music 中国区官方榜单并同步到本地音乐库，支持多选榜单，在首页「本地歌单」分区展示（直连本地库播放，无需导入）。榜单构成：每日热门歌曲（charts API）、每周热门 100 首、城市 Top 25（官方编辑歌单，ID 永久固定）、热门歌单排行（官方 RSS 每日动态排名）。

### 歌单/歌曲搜索
与 go-music-dl 一致：歌单页搜索模式下既参与「聚合」搜索，也可单独选择本插件搜索 Apple Music 官方歌单；点开歌单可预览/直接播放或「加入库」（导入歌曲经导入门禁交叉核实）。歌曲搜索同时作为门禁的同平台核实源。

### 直链说明
Apple 仅提供 30 秒试听，无全曲直链：入库为空直链 web 行，首播由核心换源兜底自动出流（与华为音乐榜单同款形态）。

### 配置说明
- 选择要同步的榜单，可以多选；
- 「热门歌单排行 TopN」控制每日动态同步榜单前几名官方歌单；
- 配置首页「本地歌单」展示的榜单数量；
- 「歌单筛选平台」控制歌单页「筛选歌单」下拉是否显示 Apple Music。

en.name: Apple Music Charts
en.description: Fetches Apple Music (China storefront) official charts into the local library: Daily Top Songs (charts API), Weekly Hot 100 (Mainland/Global/HK/KR/JP/US, permanent official playlist IDs), City Top 25 (Shanghai/Beijing/Chengdu/Guangzhou/Wuhan), and the Hot Playlists ranking (official RSS, updated daily). Songs carry title/artist/album/duration for full import-gate verification. Charts are shown directly in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page, ready to play without import. Also searches Apple Music official playlists and songs: joins the "aggregate" search modes or can be selected standalone; song search doubles as the same-catalog verification source for the import gate. Apple offers no full-track links (30s previews only), so songs are stored as empty-URL web rows and resolved via the source-fallback on first play.

chartIds.label: Select charts (multi-select)
chartIds.help: Select which Apple Music official charts/playlists to sync (multi-select). Weekly/City/fixed playlists use permanent official pl. IDs maintained by Apple.

hotPlaylistCount.label: Hot Playlists Top N
hotPlaylistCount.help: When "Hot Playlists Top N" is selected, how many top-ranked official playlists to sync daily (1~30, default 10)

homeCount.label: Home playlists shown
homeCount.help: How many imported charts to show in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page (1~50, default 6)

sortOrder.label: Home display order
sortOrder.help: Lower value sorts first. QQ (30) / Kugou (31) / Netease (32) / Huawei (33) / Apple Music (34) charts are arranged by this value in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page (1~100, default 34)

filterPlatforms.label: Playlist filter platforms
filterPlatforms.help: Choose which platforms appear in the "Filter playlists" dropdown on the playlist page; unselected platforms do not appear in the filter list. All selected by default.

scheduleEnabled.label: Participate in daily scheduled sync
scheduleEnabled.help: When off, the daily auto-sync will skip this plugin (the manual refresh button still works).

runOnBoot.label: Fetch once on container startup
runOnBoot.help: When on, MusicFlow will fetch this plugin playlists once on every start/restart (keeps chart-type plugins up to date).

batchParallel.label: Allow parallel execution
batchParallel.help: Off (default): this plugin's scheduled/batch jobs always run serially in the global queue; On: allowed to run in parallel with other plugins that enable this switch (uses more CPU but is faster).

en.documentation:
### Features
Automatically fetches Apple Music (China) official charts and syncs them into the local music library. Supports multi-selecting charts; charts are shown in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page (played straight from the local library, no import needed). Chart set: Daily Top Songs (charts API), Weekly Hot 100, City Top 25 (permanent official playlist IDs), Hot Playlists ranking (official RSS, daily).

### Playlist & song search
Like go-music-dl: joins the "aggregate" search modes and can be selected standalone. Open a playlist to preview/play directly or import it into the library; imported songs are cross-verified against Apple Music's own catalog via the import gate (search capability).

### Direct links
Apple provides 30-second previews only — songs are stored as empty-URL web rows and resolved via the core source-fallback on first play (same shape as Huawei Music Charts).

### Configuration
- Select the charts to sync (multi-select);
- "Hot Playlists Top N" controls how many top-ranked official playlists are synced daily;
- Configure how many charts the "Local Playlists" section shows on the home page;
- "Playlist filter platforms" controls whether Apple Music appears in the playlist page filter dropdown.
